data.name: Definitive Goal
data.detailed_description:
The story

The world is in full struggle between good and evil.

The red army of the dark has long colonized many territories, but the blue forces of good want to take back the entire planet to create a new world of peace and wealth.

To do this, the blue soldiers must deactivate the energy sources of the red enemies, hitting these dark sources with a beneficial and advanced spherical device.

The forces of good must liberate every territory on the planet, to create a new world of peace!

About the game

This is an arcade / fighting game with soccer/rugby dynamics.

The aim of the game is to score in the opponent's goal within the time limit, and the main concept is team play: to gain time and bonuses you have to pass the ball as much as possible to your teammates!

You win together, you lose together!

Gameplay

The aim of the game is to carry the ball in the opponent's goal within the time limit, and the main concept is team play:
to gain time and bonuses you have to pass the ball as much as possible to your teammates!

You win together, you lose together!

You are the BLUE team and you must score in the goal located UPWARDS.
To win a game and pass the level you must score in the opponent's goal, the ball (when held by a blue player) must touch the opponent's source of energy.

If the ball is touched by the dark (red) forces, then it's GAME OVER!

Procedural levels!

The levels are procedurally generated, this will allow for always different, unpredictable and fun game dynamics!

Even obstacles and vegetation are randomly generated.

The progression of the levels causes greater difficulty and a greater number of obstacles and vegetation objects  which create increasingly unpredictable, different and fun game dynamics.

Game statistics and multiple campaigns

All game and level statistics will be stored, for a constant challenge.

In addition, the game is structured in multiple campaigns, which will vary by type of scenario, obstacles, goals and balls to play with, for a very varied and fun game experience.

Three endless game campaigns

With this full version of the game which has a new procedural generation of levels, vegetation and obstacles, three main game campaigns have been maintained for now:

Forest, Grassland and Tropical

In fact, the new game mechanics allow for guaranteed fun with these campaigns.

Global leaderboards!

There are multiple global leaderboards on Steam for all players (Level, Highscores, Hooks, Passes, Levels passed) for an ever-exciting challenge throughout the game.
